P08.3: Contradiction as a first-class object — materialized entity, lifecycle, byte-identical L3 rebuild

Promote reconcile.model.Contradiction into the materialized §31 entity
(SIG-RECON-053): stable identity, claim_ids[], and resolution fields alongside
the existing severity/status/research_task_ids (additive, back-compat). Its
append-only lifecycle (open -> under_research -> resolved / accepted_unresolvable
/ superseded, SIG-RECON-056) lives as transition methods that return new records
— a contradiction is never edited in place and resolving it never deletes it
(SIG-RECON-055/021).

New reconcile.contradiction owns the orchestration: content-derived
materialization, the severity=blocking -> UNRESOLVED (U7) manual brake
(SIG-RECON-054), the publish-not-hide projection that exposes an open
unresolved_conflict (SIG-RECON-055), and the detector->task conformance check
(SIG-RECON-057). New reconcile.rebuild + a committed data/l3_rebuild_sample.json
verify a resolution is reproducible from (claims + ruleset_version +
resolver_version + as_of pair) via input_digest, gated in CI (SIG-RECON-019/020/021).

To make the detector->task contract hold uniformly, counts links its
value_disagreement task and the resolver's Phase-2 contradictions
(value_domain_mismatch, predicate_conflation) emit deterministic, content-derived
research tasks; Resolution/CountResolution gain an additive tasks field.

Design + deviations recorded in ADR-037; traceability matrix and risk register
updated (RISK-P8-10..14). make check green (ruff, mypy 132 files, 1410 tests,
verify-gen).

Requirement ids: SIG-RECON-053, SIG-RECON-054, SIG-RECON-055, SIG-RECON-056,
SIG-RECON-057, SIG-RECON-019, SIG-RECON-020, SIG-RECON-021.
